rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP server implementation by Qihoo360 that provides comprehensive file management and cloud storage operations through multiple transport protocols (STDIO, SSE, HTTP). The server offers a rich set of tools including file operations (upload, download, list, search, move, rename, delete), directory management, file sharing, and video downloading capabilities, all built with TypeScript and featuring authentication, request signing, and configurable timeout handling. Designed for AI assistants that need robust file system integration and cloud storage workflows, with particular strength in handling large file operations and media content management through its specialized video download functionality.
